cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've snapped my folder shut like you. Decision made. Which job were you hoping I'd take?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My folder's empty. Both your unsigned contracts are still in yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Signatures come after decisions. Local or abroad: what did you want?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Local. I don't want to move, but I didn't want that to choose for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I chose abroad. Keep telling me why you want to stay; I haven't signed anything.

reason: Repair the closed-folder staging conflict through spoken disclosure after B gives a preference; use unsigned contracts as real room for discussion without admitting the copied gesture was uninformed.
